description:
Professor Sophie Scott is perhaps best known for her groundbreaking work on the science of laughter, demonstrating how it supports social bonding and engages both emotional and motor brain systems. 

A celebrated public speaker and stand-up comedian, Sophie speaks on the latest research linking laughter and leadership - sharing insights on how humor fosters connection and influence. Professor Sophie Scott CBE is a leading British cognitive neuroscientist whose research has transformed understanding of human vocal communication. In 2022, she wrote The Brain: 10 Things You Should Know. Earlier she was a featured speaker at TED2015.

As Director of the Institute of Cognitive Neuroscience at University College London, Sophie heads the Speech Communication Group, investigating how the brain processes speech, voice, and nonverbal sounds. description: Some of the most meaningful relationships in our lives begin in the most unexpected ways—but fear often holds us back from taking the first step. In this talk, Dr. Maurice Dawson Jr. explores how simple actions—whether a comment online, a conversation at an event, or a bold walk-up—can lead to life-changing connections. Through practical insights and real experiences, he shows that growth, opportunity, and transformation often start with one courageous moment of reaching out. Dr. Maurice Dawson Jr. is an Associate Professor of Information Technology and Management at Illinois Tech and Director of the Center for Cyber Security and Forensics Education (C2SAFE). A Fulbright Scholar and globally recognized expert, his work spans cybersecurity, AI, and critical infrastructure protection. Dr. Dawson has advised governments worldwide and published extensively in top journals. Studies by organizations such as the World Bank and UN Women indicate that women are more likely to reinvest their income into education, healthcare, and nutrition for their families. Increasing women’s financial participation directly improves child well-being and long-term economic growth.
So when a woman earns, she doesn’t just earn.
She allocates.
She prioritizes.
She multiplies impact.
That is why financial freedom is not selfish. Bhavana Jain a gold business mentor, entrepreneur, and software developer working at the intersection of tradition and technology. I specialize in helping women — especially those with no prior background in the jewellery industry — start their own B2C gold and diamond jewellery businesses right from home. My focus is not on large showrooms or high-risk investments, but on structured, low-investment, trust-based models that allow women to begin small and scale sustainably. description:
Life rarely follows a straight path. In this TEDx talk, Kuldip Sembhi reflects on the places, faces, and phases that have shaped her journey, from early tragedy and career pivots to motherhood, personal growth, and professional success. Her story is a reminder that every twist and turn offers lessons, momentum, and opportunities to live fully. Life doesn't follow a straight path-and Kuldip is here to challenge the idea that the course of life is linear.
Through an inspiring journey that spans biomedical science, clinical research, and leading national healthcare initiatives, she has navigated unexpected twists and turns, proving that growth comes from embracing change. With a career that has taken her from diagnostic pathology to pioneering Al-driven healthcare solutions at Merck Sharp and Dohme Limited, Kuldip has been at the forefront of telehealth innovation and the fight against infectious diseases.
But beyond her professional milestones, she has also learned to adapt, evolve, and

description:
Bardaklara resim çizerek dünya gezilir mi? Olabilir...
Bazılarımız için basit ve farklı görülebilen bu soru bir hayalin ve sonrasındaki adımın görselleşmiş halidir. Bir amaç, bir hayal, bir adım.  Berk Armağan nam-ı diğer seyyahart, 1994 yılında İstanbul’da doğup yetişen, Türkçe Öğretmenliği mezunu, karton bardaklara yaptığı çizilerle dünyayı gezmeyi ideal edinmiş bir sanatçıdır. Resimle olan bağı çocukluğuna dayanan Armağan, üniversite yıllarının başında otostopla Türkiye’ye gezmeye başlayarak gezginliğe adımını attığı. Dünyayı da keşfetmek isteyen Armağan, arkadaşlarına hediye olarak çizdiği karton bardak fikrini hayalini finanse edecek bir girişime dönüştürdü.’Sanat, keyfim içindir.’’ Mottosuyla hareket eden sanatçı, Ekim 2016’da başladığı seyyahart fikriyle 31 ülke, 90+ şehir gezdi. Binlerce karton bardak çizip pek çok farklı yüzeye çizim yaptı. Starbucks, Iga Istanbul Havalimanı, Edinburgh World Heritage, Stanley gibi ulusal, uluslararası onlarca markayla işbirliği yaptı.Son zama

description:
What do you do when you’re told there’s no place for you? You stop waiting—and start creating your own. This talk explores how exclusion in football became the driving force behind building inclusive spaces for women. An award-winning football personality and pioneer, lqra Ismail is a role model paving the way for Muslim women in sports. At just 24 years old, she has already made a profound impact, advocating not only for Muslim women to enter sports but also to stay in the game. She leads by example, proving that Muslim women can — and should — play football.
Iqra made history as the captain of Somalia's national team and is the founder of Hilltop FC and NUR, two initiatives that provide a safe and inclusive space for players from under-represented backgrounds to play, watch, and engage with football.
Her groundbreaking work has earned her recognition as a Forbes 30 Under 30 honouree and the youngest-ever winner of a Blacklist Award, which celebrates Black excellence in English footb
title: Breaking Barriers: Creating Safe Spaces for Women in Football | Iqra Ismail | TEDxWarwick Salon

description: The identity that once created our success can quietly become what limits it. In The Identity Trap, this invisible loyalty to who we’ve been keeps us tied to an outdated version of ourselves even when it no longer fits. Real transformation requires the courage to be disloyal to who you’ve been. Angelica Ventrice works with high-performing leaders to bridge the gap between external success and the internal capacity required to sustain it. As a specialist in human behavior and performance psychology, she examines how identity and nervous system patterns shape leadership at pivotal moments of growth. By reframing health as a strategic asset rather than just self-care, Angelica helps leaders recalibrate their internal patterns to achieve lasting clarity, consistency, and fulfillment. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

Artificial intelligence has rapidly evolved into an everyday essential in our lives, with tools like ChatGPT leading that shift.

But as these systems become smarter, more powerful, and more independent, a deeper question begins to emerge: are we still in control, or are we simply holding on? Between Creation and Becoming explores how quickly AI has moved from simply being a buzzword — and how we must ensure we are in control of the rate it grows. Hi there! I’m an A Level student at Al Diyafah High School with a strong passion for technology. I’m always keen and aware of new and emerging technologies, fascinated by how they evolve and influence the way we think, make decisions, and interact with the world around us.

My curiosity drives me to explore not just the technical side of innovation, but also its broader impact on society, culture, and daily life. I enjoy learning how rapidly advancing systems—from AI to digital security—can create both opportunities and challenges, and I’m c
title: Between Creation and Becoming | Tarun Abraham | TEDxAl Diyafah High School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sarah Schwartz shares her travel journeys and life experiences to show why people should approach life with a “Why Not?” mindset—being willing to take on new challenges and explore unfamiliar opportunities, even when the outcome may not go as planned. She reflects on how these meaningful experiences led to close friendships and a deeper connection with herself.

She emphasizes that it’s often the small moments—the times you choose to say “why not”—that make the biggest difference over time. The greatest risk, she explains, is saying no and missing out on experiences that could transform the way you see the world. Over time, this mindset becomes a foundation: trusting yourself to navigate what comes next and having the confidence to figure things out and follow through.  Sarah Schwartz is the Director of Operations and Programs at All-American Model UN, where she helps students navigate global challenges through diplomacy and debate. A magna cum laude graduate of Vanderbilt University,
title: Why Not? | Sarah Schwartz | TEDxRiverHillHS

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We live in a world designed for convenience. From navigation apps guiding our every turn before we’ve had a chance to think, to food delivery apps suggesting our next meal instantly, technology and AI are quietly shaping our smallest decisions. What starts as helpful guidance can gradually become routine, leaving little room for active thought or genuine choice.

In my TEDx talk, “The Subtle Trade-Offs of Convenience,” I explore why sometimes choosing the harder path is not about inconvenience — it’s about growth. The moments when we pause, think, and decide for ourselves develop the skills to reason, adapt, and solve problems in an uncertain and rapidly changing world.

Let’s explore how the small choices we make every day shape the way we think, the independence we build and the future we create." Hello everyone! I’m Dhriti, a curious and motivated learner with a passion for Accounting, Finance, and Economics. In my TEDx talk, “The Subtle Trade-Offs of Convenience,” I explore why so
title: The Subtle Trade-Offs of Convenience | Dhriti Salian | TEDxAl Diyafah High School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr. J. Gregory Jolissaint shares his inspiring journey around the world as a U.S. Army veteran and healthcare executive, emphasizing the importance of embracing the opportunities presented to you and not being afraid to deviate from your original plans. He reflects on how he worked with his team to develop innovative solutions and leadership programs that train others for impactful roles in healthcare—saving lives along the way, including contributing to changes in the Army’s first aid kit. He also helped create a program within a large healthcare system to deliver comprehensive, high-quality care to military service members, veterans, and their families.

Through his story, he highlights the power of saying yes to opportunities and responsibilities. He encourages others not to feel overly disappointed or disillusioned if their path after high school doesn’t go exactly as planned, but instead to view unexpected directions as opportunities to grow where they have been planted. description:
◦ MRI（磁気共鳴画像法）を専門とする放射線科医で、非造影でがんを描出する DWIBS法 を考案し、画像診断の可能性を広げてきた。「検査の精度」だけでなく、人が検診を受けるかどうか に着目し、痛くない・見られない乳がん検診 という新しい選択肢を提案している。医療技術が人の行動を変え、早期発見につながる社会を目指し、患者にとって“受けたくなる医療”のあり方を問い続けている。
Dr. Taro Takahara is a radiologist specializing in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
He developed the DWIBS method, a non-contrast MRI technique that enables sensitive detection of cancer throughout the body. More recently, his focus has shifted from diagnostic accuracy alone to a fundamental question: What makes people willing to undergo medical screening? By rethinking long-standing assumptions, Dr. Takahara helped realize the world’s first breast cancer screening that is both painless and preserves personal privacy.
His work explores how medical innovation can change human behavior—and ultimately, save lives.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Drawing from her conservation work, Nela Ekpenyong shows that meaningful change often starts long before capital, with intention, consistency,
and focus. She challenges the assumption that impact begins with money. In landscapes where resources are limited, progress depends on how well we understand and mobilize what already exists around us. She provides a different hierarchy of resources: purpose first, then relationships and skills, and only later capital. By shifting attention away from scarcity and toward agency, conservation & development
are reframed more broadly, as a practice of alignment rather than accumulation. Nela Duke Ekpenyong is an investor, award-winning conservationist, philanthropic advisor, and entrepreneur with over a decade of experience driving large-scale growth and development initiatives across Africa. With a deep passion for sustainability, innovation, and economic empowerment, she has played a pivotal role in shaping Africa’s investment and conservation la
title: The Resource More Powerful than Money | Nela Ekpenyong | TEDxAbuja

author: TEDx Talks
description:
You’re not clumsy. If you’ve dropped your keys, missed a step, or spilled something recently, your body may be trying to get your attention. In this talk, Dr. Princess Cullum introduces “The Dropsies” a sharp reframe of everyday mishaps as signals from a nervous system under pressure. After a late-night ER visit revealed anxiety, not a heart attack, she asked a different question: What had her body been saying all along? What if those moments aren’t mistakes but messages?
